fields.name: record_id
fields.description: {"value": "Unique identifier used to track this permit within BSEED's Accela database.", "fieldValueType": "uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: address
fields.description: {"value": "Property address of the structure that the building permit was issued for.", "fieldValueType": "locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: submitted_date
fields.description: {"value": "Date the application was received. Applications are submitted to BSEED by property owners or licensed professionals.", "fieldValueType": "dateAndTime"}

fields.name: issued_date
fields.description: {"value": "Date the permit was issued. The permit is issued when the permit application is approved. Permits are issued by BSEED staff.", "fieldValueType": "dateAndTime"}

fields.name: work_description
fields.description: {"value": "Notes and further specifications about the building permit. They may contain details about the location information, related grants, or related building permits.", "fieldValueType": "description"}

fields.name: permit_type
fields.description: {"value": "The category of building permit that was issued.", "fieldValueType": "typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: construction_type
fields.description: {"value": "", "fieldValueType": "typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: current_use_type
fields.description: {"value": "The building's current Type of Use. It is defined by the Michigan Building Code in conjunction with the City of Detroit Zoning Ordinance.", "fieldValueType": "typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: proposed_use_type
fields.description: {"value": "The Type of Use that the permit applicant proposed for the relevant building space after the permitted work is completed.", "fieldValueType": "typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: use_group
fields.description: {"value": "", "fieldValueType": "typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: zoning_designation
fields.description: {"value": "The type of zoning district where the building is located. The City of Detroit Zoning Ordinance is written by the City Planning Commission and approved by City Council.", "fieldValueType": "typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: num_stories
fields.description: {"value": "Stories is the total number of floors in the building. Permits may be issued for individual floors or groups of floors.", "fieldValueType": "countOrAmount"}

fields.name: num_units
fields.description: {"value": "", "fieldValueType": "countOrAmount"}

fields.name: amt_estimated_contractor_cost
fields.description: {"value": "Cost estimated by contractor, when included in permit application."}

fields.name: amt_estimated_department_cost
fields.description: {"value": "Cost estimate calculated by BSEED using the Michigan Bureau of Construction Codes (BCC) Square Footage Cost Table. Department Estimated Cost is used to determine permit fees when Contractor Estimated Cost is less than the cost estimate that is based on the BCC Square Footage Cost Table."}

fields.name: is_open_to_elements
fields.description: {"value": "At the time of building permit application, has the structure been open to the elements for more than one month in the last 3 years?", "fieldValueType": "binary"}

fields.name: is_missing_portions_of_building
fields.description: {"value": "At the time of building permit application, is the structure(s) missing windows, doors, or any portion of the roof?", "fieldValueType": "binary"}

fields.name: is_purchased_from_dlba
fields.description: {"value": "Was the property purchased from the Detroit Land Bank Authority?", "fieldValueType": "binary"}

fields.name: is_in_dlba_compliance
fields.description: {"value": "At the time of building permit application, is the property in the Detroit Land Bank Authority (DLBA) compliance process?", "fieldValueType": "binary"}

fields.name: has_change_in_units
fields.description: {"value": "Will this permit change the number of residential units?", "fieldValueType": "binary"}

fields.name: is_vacant
fields.description: {"value": "At the time of building permit application, is the building vacant?", "fieldValueType": "binary"}

fields.name: neighborhood
fields.description: {"value": "Neighborhood where the address of property is located.", "fieldValueType": "locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: council_district
fields.description: {"value": "Council district where the address of property is located.", "fieldValueType": "locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: zip_code
fields.description: {"value": "Zip code where the address of property is located.", "fieldValueType": "locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: street_number
fields.description: {"value": "Street number of the property address where the permit was issued.", "fieldValueType": "description"}

fields.name: street_prefix
fields.description: {"value": "Street prefix / directional of the property address where the permit was issued.", "fieldValueType": "description"}

fields.name: street_name
fields.description: {"value": "Street name of the property address where the permit was issued.", "fieldValueType": "locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: street_type
fields.description: {"value": "Street type for the property address where the permit was issued.", "fieldValueType": "typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: parcel_id
fields.description: {"value": "Unique number used to track the parcel of land the property is located on. Parcel IDs are assigned by the Office of the Assessor.", "fieldValueType": "uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: address_id
fields.description: {"value": "Unique number used to identify the physical address of the location for which a building permit was issued. Address IDs are assigned when an address is geocoded using Detroit's Base Units.", "fieldValueType": "uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: {"value": "Longitudinal geographic coordinate of the address of the structure for which the building permit was issued.", "fieldValueType": "coordinate"}

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: {"value": "Latitudinal geographic coordinate of the address of the structure for which the building permit was issued.", "fieldValueType": "coordinate"}
